notes.title: Evasion 1.0.7
notes.content:
Update to Unity 6 and Universal render pipeline (which is a jump forward in technology)
Improved some levels
Less flickering and blinking, improved metallic look
Improved some overlapping ui effects
Many minor improvements and fixes

notes.title: Evasion from Cluster 42 -> V1.0.0
notes.content:
Added one more level, now there are 16.
Estimated play-time till the end is 12-20 hours depending on difficulty etc.
And beneath the story mode there is also the endless arcade mode and the possibilty to play every level viewed from top down or side-scrolling, have enemies always appeearing the same way or totally random...
